name: Probe R22 I
mExpression: let Raw = AnalysisServices.Database("SSASPROD","BIQLTabular",[ Query = "EVALUATE VAR R = FILTER ( 'Currency Rates', 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeFrom] = ""EUR"" && 'Currency Rates'[CurrencyCodeTo] = ""USD"" && 'Currency Rates'[CalendarDate] = 'Currency Rates'[PeriodEndDate] ) RETURN ROW ( ""AddressRows"", COUNTROWS ( 'Address' ), ""AddressNums"", DISTINCTCOUNT ( 'Address'[Address Num] ), ""AddrNameVariants"", COUNTROWS ( SUMMARIZE ( 'Address', 'Address'[Address Num], 'Address'[Address Name] ) ), ""RateRows"", COUNTROWS ( R ), ""RateMonths"", COUNTROWS ( SUMMARIZE ( R, 'Currency Rates'[PeriodEndDate] ) ), ""RateMonthEnds"", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( R, 'Currency Rates'[CalendarDate] = EOMONTH ( 'Currency Rates'[CalendarDate], 0 ) ) ), ""RateMin"", MIN ( 'Currency Rates'[PeriodEndDate] ), ""RateMax"", MAXX ( R, 'Currency Rates'[PeriodEndDate] ), ""POR322976Name"", MAXX ( FILTER ( 'Address', 'Address'[Address Num] = 322976 ), 'Address'[Address Name] ) )" ]), Data = Table.TransformColumnNames(Raw, each if Text.StartsWith(_, "[") and Text.EndsWith(_, "]") then Text.Middle(_, 1, Text.Length(_) - 2) else _) in Data
